newsitem.title: USA: Hungarian Broadcasting says revs up.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian Broadcasting says revs up.

text.p: Hungarian Broadcasting Corp said on Friday that its revenues increased by 223 percent to $1,239,418 in the six months ended December 31, 1996, from $383,671 in the year-ago period.

Operating costs and expenses, including amortization of deferred program costs, increased to $2,415,859 in the six months ended December 31, 1996, from $678,598 in the year-ago period, the company said.

Hungarian Broadcasting is a satellite-to-cable television broadcaster. In April 1996, after operating at a low level, the company relaunched its Budapest-based television station, MSAT, accounting for a dramatic increase in advertising revenues.
